mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 0.3 percentage points signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 5% signals weakening residential investment and lower construction-related earnings, which drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below -0.5% signals weaker manufacturing activity and reduced corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the Consumer Price Index above 0.4% signals tighter monetary policy is likely, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressure and inflation risk, prompting higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income above 1.5% signals weakening consumer purchasing power, which reduces demand for goods and services and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in out-of-sample tests.
